coverage.target: D1 — pinned source; the pin is what the recorded digest is compared against on each refresh
D1 — checksum committed with the vendored output and written by the refresh, so it moves in the same pull request as the types it corresponds to
D1 — in the interim the recorded digest covers the revision of api-documentation.md the types were transcribed from, since no machine-readable contract exists to digest
D3 — generator runs able to read one document and write one directory; no deploy, publish or registry credentials
D1 and D2 — output reaches the repository only through a pull request; the human diff review is the step that catches what provenance checks cannot
D2 — scheduled regeneration comparison that opens a pull request carrying the shape diff, updated in place rather than reopened
D2 — with no contract source, the job reports and exits successfully rather than failing, so it is not red for a reason nobody can fix before it has ever been useful
D5 — sections non-optional at the type level, so a save omitting it does not compile
D5 — closed enumeration for the subscription action and non-optional request bodies
D5 — visualStyling typed opaque so no component can read it without going through the one parsing module
D5 — chat reply text marked untrusted, so a call reaching a raw-HTML sink is visible in review
D5 — no property image field exists, so no placeholder can be rendered
D6 — token fields typed as opaque credentials rather than strings
D6 — no logging, serialisation or display behaviour defined for any shape in this unit

reverse.target: generator and refresh job covered by the team's mandated dependency scanning and SHA-pinned CI actions. Added at review of the previous stage, so it has no NFRx.y row in that stage's requirements file to trace back to; it implements team.md's standing practice rather than a unit requirement
